answer.explanation: Across repeated measurements at a 3ms period, s50000_aall consistently demonstrates the lowest periodic wake-up P95 latency, regularly achieving sub-100 us latencies (e.g., ~87.35 us and ~87.39 us) and avoiding the higher latency spikes seen in s50000_aone and the ~800-1400 us latencies observed for all s1000000 configurations.

Across the measured runs, s50000_aall consistently achieves the lowest P95 latency, often dipping below 90 us (e.g., 82.488 us in retrieval-3-7-s50000_aall and 87.347 us in retrieval-3-9-s50000_aall), substantially outperforming s50000_aone and the 1000000 configs.
